claims.statement: Denver Ed Smith said Tom Allen handled him when Smith beat Goddard in eighteen rounds before the Olympic Club in New Orleans.
claims.excerpt: whipped him in New Orleans in eighteen rounds, before the Olympic Club, when Tom Allen handled me

claims.statement: Tom Allen and many people believed Denver Ed Smith could eat up and spit out Sharkey, Maher, Corbett or Fitzsimmons.
claims.excerpt: Tom Allen and many people believe can eat up and spit out Sharkey

quotes.speaker: Denver Ed Smith
quotes.text: If Allen had been handling me I would have won.
quotes.topic: Allen as his handler against Goddard

notes: Article is about Denver Ed Smith; Allen did not fight in it. Hibernian games and Smith's other fights are not about Allen and are left out. Goddard is printed without a first name.
